name: get_mla_kv_buffer
description: Gathers MLA KV rows. For each loc entry, copies kv_buffer[loc] and splits the last dimension into nope_dim and rope_dim outputs. cache_k_nope and cache_k_rope are shape/dtype templates only; their values are not read. Returns two newly allocated tensors [n_loc,nope_dim] and [n_loc,rope_dim], or two empty tensors when n_loc==0. Current tests exercise bfloat16 kv_buffer with nope_dim=512, rope_dim=64 and n_loc 1..4096; inputs are read-only.
